name: noma
statusNote: Michelin removed its three stars in June 2026 because it had been operating abroad without a permanent restaurant in Copenhagen; it plans to reopen in the city
statusNoteDa: Michelin fjernede de tre stjerner i juni 2026, fordi restauranten havde drevet virksomhed i udlandet uden en fast restaurant i København; den planlægger at genåbne i byen
statusNoteZh: 由於長期在海外營運、在哥本哈根沒有固定餐廳，米其林於 2026 年 6 月撤銷其三星；餐廳計劃重返哥本哈根
